title: Microsoft 365 admin center: email notifications for organizational data processing status
summary: The briefing passes: its planned recipients, default, unsubscribe option and target dates match the roadmap. Microsoft Learn supports the surrounding service's licensing, roles and validation-status path; the notification-specific gaps remain appropriately qualified.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service brings employee data into Microsoft 365.
claims.quote: Organizational data is employee data that describes the employees in your organization and can be ingested manually or using supported HRIS systems.

claims.claim: The service supports organizational data from HR systems and other sources.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 Organizational Data Service supports multiple connector options, allowing you to bring organizational data into Microsoft 365 from HR systems, data lakes, and custom applications.

claims.claim: CSV Import is a documented connector option.
claims.quote: CSV Import | You upload a .csv file directly to Microsoft.

claims.claim: Workday is a documented connector option.
claims.quote: Workday Connector | Microsoft pulls data directly from Workday's Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP) APIs using Workday credentials that you provide.

claims.claim: SAP SuccessFactors is a documented connector option.
claims.quote: SAP SuccessFactors Connector | Microsoft pulls data directly from SAP SuccessFactors's public APIs using SAP SuccessFactors credentials that you provide.

claims.claim: Azure Blob Storage is a documented connector option.
claims.quote: Azure Blob Storage Connector | Microsoft pulls your .csv file from Azure Blob using a Blob container URL you provide.

claims.claim: An API-based connector is documented.
claims.quote: API-based Connector (Public Preview) | You send a .csv file from any HRIS source to the Microsoft API.
